source_name: Mesto Žilina – Verejné obstarávanie
why_relevant: Regional city buyer; Žilina operates regulated parking with NFC/Apple Pay/Google Pay-capable machines, so its procurement page and parking site document acceptance-hardware and payment-service purchases.

source_name: Mesto Nitra – Verejné obstarávanie
why_relevant: Mid-size regional-capital buyer; representative of the tier of cities now rolling out e-parking and cashless municipal fee collection.

source_name: Mestská časť Košice – Staré Mesto, Verejné obstarávanie
why_relevant: Example of the borough (mestská časť) layer — a separate legal buyer class that publishes low-value calls on its own page and maintains both ÚVO and EKS profiles; boroughs buy parking and local fee-collection services independently of the city.

source_name: Košický samosprávny kraj – Úradná tabuľa / Verejné obstarávanie a archív zákaziek s nízkou hodnotou
why_relevant: Model VÚC (regional self-government) noticeboard: publishes above-threshold, below-threshold AND low-value contracts, plus an archive of §9(9)/§117 zákazky s nízkou hodnotou — the exact sub-bulletin layer named in this cell's rationale. Also hosts an internal-audit register of procurement findings.

source_name: Žilinský samosprávny kraj – Verejné obstarávanie
why_relevant: Second confirmed VÚC procurement noticeboard; regions procure regional bus transport (prímestská doprava) contracts that increasingly bundle e-ticketing and card acceptance.

source_name: Transparency International Slovensko – Otvorená samospráva (transparentnosť miest a žúp)
why_relevant: Watchdog ranking that audits how (and whether) 100 Slovak cities and all VÚC publish procurement information — tells the collector which municipal noticeboards are reliable and which systematically under-publish, and flags contested awards.

source_name: PAAS – Bratislavský parkovací asistent (platby, prevádzka)
why_relevant: Operational site of the capital's city-wide parking scheme; documents which payment rails are live (apps, SMS to 2200 operated by Mediatex after a tender, card), which is a direct read-out of who won municipal payment-service contracts.

source_name: imhd.sk – dokumentácia taríf a odbavovacích systémov MHD
why_relevant: Enthusiast/expert portal documenting Slovak urban transport fare and validation systems in unusual technical detail (e.g. 'bezkontaktná platobná karta ako električenka', IDS BK tariff from 1.7.2026) — an early-warning indicator that a municipal payments procurement has been executed and gone live.

source_name: Vendor-side reference sources: ParkDots (mestský parkovací systém), CVAK platobná aplikácia
why_relevant: Suppliers of Slovak municipal parking/payment systems publish city reference lists and go-live announcements, which reverse-engineer into a map of which municipality bought what and when — often faster than the buyer's own noticeboard.

source_name: Technické služby / mestské podniky (napr. Technické služby mesta Humenné) – aktuality a obstarávanie
why_relevant: Municipal utility companies (technické služby, mestské podniky) are a distinct buyer class that actually operates parking machines and cash collection for small and mid-size towns, and publishes its own small-contract notices and deployment news.

source_name: Národná banka Slovenska – Profil verejného obstarávateľa (own site)
why_relevant: Central bank's own procurement hub: states that all above-threshold tenders run through IS JOSEPHINE, publishes standard tender conditions (dated 1.10.2025), links to its UVO profile and to sub-pages for contracts/orders/invoices and selected tenders. Direct visibility into NBS demand for cash-handling, banknote processing, payment/clearing and IT systems.

source_name: ÚVO – Profil verejného obstarávateľa NBS (profile ID 8643)
why_relevant: The legally authoritative mirror of NBS procurement documents on the regulator's platform, with a stable numeric profile ID (8643) that makes long-term automated monitoring feasible independently of NBS website redesigns.

source_name: ÚVO – Profil verejného obstarávateľa SZRB (profile ID 9586)
why_relevant: SZRB's own procurement page explicitly points here as its profile. SZRB has recently tendered a Core Banking System (~EUR 2.95m) and a regulatory reporting IS — exactly the banking-technology demand this cell exists to capture.

source_name: SZRB – Obstarávanie prác, tovarov a služieb
why_relevant: SZRB's own procurement landing page, confirming it applies Act 343/2015 and linking to its ÚVO profile, summary reports and its orders/invoices register. Entry point for snowballing SZRB IT tenders.

source_name: SZRB – Súhrnné správy o zákazkach (summary reports on low-value contracts)
why_relevant: Quarterly summary reports capture the below-threshold contracts that never reach the Vestník or TED — often the small maintenance/licence/service deals that reveal which vendors already sit inside the bank.

source_name: EXIMBANKA SR – Profil verejného obstarávateľa
why_relevant: Eximbanka's own four-level profile, splitting nadlimitné/podlimitné zákazky, §9 ods.9 contracts and summary reports on contracts over EUR 1,000/year. Contact for discrepancies: preti@eximbanka.sk. Covers a state export bank's IT, insurance-system and service demand.

source_name: Vestník verejného obstarávania (ÚVO official procurement bulletin, eForms)
why_relevant: The legally definitive daily publication of Slovak procurement notices, now fed by the eForms IS and full-text searchable. Every notice from NBS, Eximbanka, SZRB and SIH above threshold must appear here first; it is the canonical timestamp for a tender's existence.

source_name: UVOstat – entity dossier for SZRB (IČO 00682420) and other authorities
why_relevant: Third-party aggregator that restructures ÚVO data into per-entity dossiers (tenders, contracts, finances, supplier connections). Far easier to parse than the ÚVO SPA and gives historical award series and winning-supplier links for the state banks.

source_name: Slovak Investment Holding – Výber finančných sprostredkovateľov (NDF II)
why_relevant: SIH procures differently from the other three: instead of technology, it runs public procurements and open calls to SELECT FINANCIAL INTERMEDIARIES for instruments (FLPG for R&D&I, energy-efficiency credit instruments, social-economy guarantees). Useful as a map of which Slovak banks are contracting with the state, and occasionally for fund-administration/IT services.

source_name: SITA Financie (vofinanciach.sk) – procurement reporting on state banks
why_relevant: Slovak financial newswire that reliably reports state-bank tenders with values and scope — e.g. SZRB's core banking system tender (~EUR 2.95m) and its new reporting information system. Gives narrative context and sometimes names bidders before award notices publish.

source_name: sk.openprocurements.com – per-tender mirrored pages for NBS
why_relevant: Aggregator that mirrors individual Slovak tenders as stable, crawlable static pages — useful as a historical archive when ÚVO/JOSEPHINE pages rotate. The example is precisely an NBS banknote-processing-equipment servicing tender.

source_name: verejnesutaze.sk – NBS procurer page (procurer 89)
why_relevant: Commercial tender-alerting service with per-procurer pages; provides an alternative index of NBS tenders and can surface notices missed by an ÚVO-only pipeline.

source_name: eZakazky / eTrhovisko (ezakazky.sk) – electronic marketplace listings
why_relevant: A search hit surfaced an eTrhovisko tender detail page in the SZRB context, indicating that some state-bank below/at-threshold purchases of commonly available goods and services run through this electronic marketplace rather than JOSEPHINE or EVO.

source_name: MF SR – founder/shareholder pages for Eximbanka SR and SZRB
why_relevant: Establishes the ownership/control chain that makes these banks contracting authorities at all (MF SR exercises shareholder rights; SIH is wholly owned by SZRB). Useful for keeping the actor map correct after mergers or restructurings, and as a pointer to annual reports and governance documents that foreshadow investment programmes.
